g.text: #60 Separate the starting seeds of residual particles

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #637680

g.text: Fixed seed; same horizontal cell and weather situation; vertical layer, source group and split index vary.

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #637680

g.text: Labels identify initial seed pairs; they are not random draw values. k = layer; SG = source group; p = split index.

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #263940

g.text: The original initialization gives all 12 contexts the same pair. The patch includes their residual identities.

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #637680

g.text: Current PR head replay of 12 selected contexts (i = 15, j = 21, situation = 7).

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #637680

g.text: This demonstrates the repeated-seed defect; it does not establish globally collision-free or statistically independent streams.
